dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: TAL CORVUS — WARRENS — BEFORE DAWN

dialogueInline.speaker: MECHANIC
dialogueInline.text: You've had that since the water rationing. I want it back.

dialogueInline.speaker: NEIGHBOR
dialogueInline.text: I borrowed it. I didn't steal it.

dialogueInline.speaker: MECHANIC
dialogueInline.text: I said you could have it for a week.

dialogueInline.speaker: NEIGHBOR
dialogueInline.text: It was a particularly long week.

dialogueInline.speaker: MOTHER
dialogueInline.text: They've been doing this since before my daughter was born.

dialogueInline.speaker: CHILD
dialogueInline.text: Then why doesn't he take it?

dialogueInline.speaker: MOTHER
dialogueInline.text: Because he's very fond of complaining about it. He'd miss it terribly.

dialogueInline.speaker: CHILD
dialogueInline.text: Which one's Gravefire?

dialogueInline.speaker: MOTHER
dialogueInline.text: The one at the civilian berth. That captain's been arguing with the departure office since midnight.

panelPlan: TAL CORVUS — WARRENS — BEFORE DAWN. A queue bends around working pipes, sleeping families, portable heaters, and skiffs being checked for the third evacuation.
The mechanic makes a wounded gesture. The mother tightens a heater strap and immediately has to undo it when her daughter complains it pinches.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *TAL CORVUS — WARRENS — BEFORE DAWN. A queue bends around working pipes, sleeping families, portable heaters, and skiffs being checked for the third evacuation window. A child stands on a crate to draw the ships she expects to see. Two neighbors are arguing over a dented kettle.*
*The mechanic makes a wounded gesture. The mother tightens a heater strap and immediately has to undo it when her daughter complains it pinches.*

dialogueInline.speaker: CHILD
dialogueInline.text: Is she losing?

dialogueInline.speaker: MOTHER
dialogueInline.text: The departure office is losing.

dialogueInline.speaker: MECHANIC
dialogueInline.text: Didn't we ask them to come?

dialogueInline.speaker: NEIGHBOR
dialogueInline.text: We asked someone to protect us. They're not always the same thing.

panelPlan: The child adds a small ship to her drawing. On the far side of the station, Thunderbreak and its Fleet screen come into view. The queue quiets. Some people.
The mother folds the drawing and gives it back to her daughter. The child draws Fleet's cruiser as large as the paper will allow.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *The child adds a small ship to her drawing. On the far side of the station, Thunderbreak and its Fleet screen come into view. The queue quiets. Some people move toward the viewing rail. Others move away.*
*The mother folds the drawing and gives it back to her daughter. The child draws Fleet's cruiser as large as the paper will allow.*

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: THUNDERBREAK COMMAND

dialogueInline.speaker: TACTICAL
dialogueInline.text: Third-window orders received. Offensive batteries remain under Admiralty release.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: And the Commodore?

dialogueInline.speaker: TACTICAL
dialogueInline.text: Her tribunal finding stands. Thunderbreak remains under your command.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I was beginning to worry they'd take my favorite chair away.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Shift our shields toward the civilian route. Guns stay dark unless we receive release. Keep a reserve where it can actually turn.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: Lieutenant, I expect you understand the distinction between guarding a corridor and surrendering it to the first captain who shouts for help.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Yes, Admiral. Unfortunately, disabled ships are poor listeners. They drift through the lines you've drawn.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: Protect the crossing without abandoning the blockade.

panelPlan: THUNDERBREAK COMMAND. Lieutenant Erin Deka surveys the third-window approach. The patched cruiser still carries the scars of earlier rescues. Its weapons are.
Deka marks the distant vessels: Gravefire at the departure mouth, Sunlash at the far exit, Fleet in a narrow outer screen.
Dominion appears on a secured command link.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *THUNDERBREAK COMMAND. Lieutenant Erin Deka surveys the third-window approach. The patched cruiser still carries the scars of earlier rescues. Its weapons are not released for offensive fire.*
*Deka marks the distant vessels: Gravefire at the departure mouth, Sunlash at the far exit, Fleet in a narrow outer screen.*
*Dominion appears on a secured command link.*

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I'll do what I can with the cruiser I have. If you know where to find a second one, I'll gladly accept it.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: Your predecessor was also fond of presenting limitations as invitations.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: She taught us a great deal about limitations.

dialogueInline.speaker: TACTICAL
dialogueInline.text: You didn't mention what you'll do if the line breaks.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I thought I'd wait for it to break. I prefer to be disappointed by the actual disaster.

panelPlan: The link closes. The tactical officer studies Deka.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *The link closes. The tactical officer studies Deka.*

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: DOCK GANTRY

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: A boundary is a splendid thing. Everybody can see exactly where your authority stops.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: It's where my captains agreed to protect civilians. They don't need to answer to me anywhere else.

dialogueInline.speaker: BILLIE
dialogueInline.text: You make it sound like our people volunteered to be janitors for Fleet's traffic.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: They volunteered because the ships carry families from our own warrens.

dialogueInline.speaker: BILLIE
dialogueInline.text: I know who they carry.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: Then stop making them nervous for the pleasure of making Fleet nervous.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: My position is outside the lane.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: Your cameras are outside it. Your hull is half across the reserve's turn.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: The people need to see somebody defending them.

panelPlan: DOCK GANTRY. Abby has posted an evacuation protection boundary. Pike has put Broken Oath where it will be unmistakably visible to the people below. Billie has.
Pike gestures toward the waiting crowd, whose members can see his unmistakable silhouette.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *DOCK GANTRY. Abby has posted an evacuation protection boundary. Pike has put Broken Oath where it will be unmistakably visible to the people below. Billie has a patrol within sight of the forbidden lane, careful not to cross it yet.*
*Pike gestures toward the waiting crowd, whose members can see his unmistakable silhouette.*

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: They need the reserve to get past you if a tug fails. You're confusing being seen with being useful.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: You know what happens if you keep telling captains they're not useful? They start trying to prove otherwise.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: I told Pike to move. I told Billie not to shoot. That's been my entire diplomatic achievement today.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: It's early. You can offend the other half before lunch.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: You're directly across Billie's approach. I wouldn't put anyone else there.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: You mean nobody else would agree.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: I mean I trust you.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: That's worse. Now I have to be careful.

panelPlan: Later, Tess joins Abby on the maintenance rail. Below them a loader is testing the same mechanism for the fifth time.
Abby glances toward Gravefire.
She squeezes Abby's shoulder as she passes. Abby watches her go with an anxiety that never enters her command voice.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *Later, Tess joins Abby on the maintenance rail. Below them a loader is testing the same mechanism for the fifth time.*
*Abby glances toward Gravefire.*
*She squeezes Abby's shoulder as she passes. Abby watches her go with an anxiety that never enters her command voice.*

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: AURIC FREEPORT

dialogueInline.speaker: WALLACE
dialogueInline.text: Those pallets were booked through tomorrow. We move them and they'll spend another day on the dock, charging us for the privilege.

dialogueInline.speaker: HALEV
dialogueInline.text: I know. Clear the floor anyway. People can't sleep on pallets no matter how expensive they are.

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: We can get the skiffs to the exit. What we can't do is park them there while your arrivals desk debates whether a family has a berth.

dialogueInline.speaker: HALEV
dialogueInline.text: Then the desk meets them at the dock.

dialogueInline.speaker: JEX
dialogueInline.text: I'd suggest it meet them with better news than last time.

dialogueInline.speaker: WALLACE
dialogueInline.text: What would you suggest, specifically?

dialogueInline.speaker: JEX
dialogueInline.text: Not charging them for a night they haven't lived through. But while I'm being generous, I have something else.

panelPlan: AURIC FREEPORT. Halev has ordered freight cleared from a heated hall to receive Tal Corvus evacuees. Wallace is counting the lost throughput. Naomi is counting.
He shows the three independently positioned hostile interception screens. Naomi recognizes the geometry before anyone else.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *AURIC FREEPORT. Halev has ordered freight cleared from a heated hall to receive Tal Corvus evacuees. Wallace is counting the lost throughput. Naomi is counting the minutes until the transit window. Jex arrives with three hostile screen traces and a private worry he will not explain.*
*He shows the three independently positioned hostile interception screens. Naomi recognizes the geometry before anyone else.*

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: One takes Gravefire. One takes Sunlash. The third waits for the reserve to chase either of them.

dialogueInline.speaker: JEX
dialogueInline.text: If I charged you for that observation, could you look a little more impressed?

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: You didn't get this from a public notice.

dialogueInline.speaker: JEX
dialogueInline.text: No.

dialogueInline.speaker: HALEV
dialogueInline.text: What do you want?

dialogueInline.speaker: JEX
dialogueInline.text: Keep a channel listening for Tali. If anybody hears from that corner of the route, don't put it in a council report before you tell me.

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: They'll know we've seen them.

dialogueInline.speaker: JEX
dialogueInline.text: I was hoping you'd surprise them.

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: I intend to. The surprise is that I'll be there before they are.

panelPlan: Halev agrees. Naomi moves Sunlash to the threatened exit anyway.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *Halev agrees. Naomi moves Sunlash to the threatened exit anyway.*

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: TAL CORVUS — DEPARTURE MOUTH / ORBIT

dialogueInline.speaker: TACTICAL
dialogueInline.text: They're pulling our escorts in different directions. Pike's sitting where the reserve needs to turn.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Tell him there's a tug behind his cameras. If he wants a good picture, he can try turning around.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: Thunderbreak, Ashfang is squeezing the lane. I can bring the tugs out, but I can't turn them twice.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I'll give you our armored side.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: Good. And keep the guns away from their noses. One frightened pilot sees a battery turn and we'll all spend the evening catching pieces of tug.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Batteries stay dark. Get the people moving.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: Move the ship. You don't have to leave the watch, just stop blocking the reserve.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: If I move, the audience will think I'm backing down.

panelPlan: The hostile screens hold their positions. Broken Oath's camera-facing stance obstructs the reserve. Billie nudges Ashfang close enough to make civilian tugs.
On Gravefire, Tess studies the cramped departure mouth.
At the gantry Abby sends Pike a direct warning.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *The hostile screens hold their positions. Broken Oath's camera-facing stance obstructs the reserve. Billie nudges Ashfang close enough to make civilian tugs tighten their approach. None of the attackers needs to be inside Abby's protective boundary to put civilians in danger.*
*On Gravefire, Tess studies the cramped departure mouth.*
*At the gantry Abby sends Pike a direct warning.*

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: There won't be an audience if those skiffs don't launch.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: You don't understand what it means for people to see a captain stand his ground.

dialogueInline.speaker: ABBY
dialogueInline.text: I understand perfectly. I also know a ship can stand its ground in the wrong place.

panelPlan: Pike does not move in time. The window is opening.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *Pike does not move in time. The window is opening.*

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: TAL CORVUS — THIRD WINDOW

dialogueInline.speaker: SECOND
dialogueInline.text: The second hostile screen is shifting to make us follow it.

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: Then let it enjoy the trip. Keep our nose on the exit marker.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: They panicked on the first flash. I warned you that would happen.

dialogueInline.speaker: BILLIE
dialogueInline.text: I didn't hit the lane.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: You didn't have to.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: Kill the broadcast angle. Bring us around.

dialogueInline.speaker: PILOT
dialogueInline.text: That puts our stern in the pressure wake.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: I can see that. The tug has children on it.

dialogueInline.speaker: TACTICAL
dialogueInline.text: The other tug's outside the reserve. We can't reach it from here without opening the flank.

panelPlan: The third window opens. Civilian skiffs begin departing under ordinary measured corridor markers. Sunlash takes the far exit. Gravefire walks the line out of.
Deka commits Thunderbreak's armored flank to shield the scattered tugs. Pike sees the first vessel drifting beyond safety. For a moment his camera.
A junior Fleet escort officer hears the report from their own bridge. No one has ordered the officer to abandon station.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *The third window opens. Civilian skiffs begin departing under ordinary measured corridor markers. Sunlash takes the far exit. Gravefire walks the line out of the berth, while Deka keeps Thunderbreak between the tugs and the waiting screen.*

*Billie fires a warning shot outside the protected lane. The sound will never reach the civilians, but its consequences will: two skiffs dodge, a tug loses thrust near drifting wreckage, and another crosses toward Fleet's reserve line.*

*Deka commits Thunderbreak's armored flank to shield the scattered tugs. Pike sees the first vessel drifting beyond safety. For a moment his camera feed shows the faces of people who cannot wait for him to look heroic. He swings Broken Oath out of its prepared shot.*
*He retrieves the first tug, damaging his carefully maintained profile. The second keeps drifting.*
*A junior Fleet escort officer hears the report from their own bridge. No one has ordered the officer to abandon station.*

dialogueInline.speaker: ESCORT OFFICER
dialogueInline.text: I'm going after it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ESCORT SECOND
dialogueInline.text: Standing orders say hold.

dialogueInline.speaker: ESCORT OFFICER
dialogueInline.text: I've read them.

dialogueInline.speaker: TACTICAL
dialogueInline.text: Deka, the junior escort's left formation. They've exposed our reserve flank.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I see it. Bring Thunderbreak around. We cover the gap until they're back.

dialogueInline.speaker: TACTICAL
dialogueInline.text: That gives the third hostile screen a clear look at us.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Then let's give them the old side. The one we can afford to scrape again.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: That escort left its station without authority. If the next ship does the same, who guards the rest?

dialogueInline.speaker: SELENE
dialogueInline.text: Deka held the gap. The tug's crew has been brought aboard.

panelPlan: The escort turns. An obvious and dangerous gap opens in the screen.
Thunderbreak turns. The junior escort reaches the stranded tug while Deka absorbs the formation cost. At the Relic Court, Dominion watches the unauthorized.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *The escort turns. An obvious and dangerous gap opens in the screen.*
*Thunderbreak turns. The junior escort reaches the stranded tug while Deka absorbs the formation cost. At the Relic Court, Dominion watches the unauthorized break and the covering maneuver.*

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: The first fact doesn't vanish because you prefer the second.

dialogueInline.speaker: SELENE
dialogueInline.text: I don't prefer facts, Admiral. I enter them. Both, if you'll allow it.

panelPlan: He makes her hold the recording. His objection is not theatrical; he has seen formations fail because captains each saved the nearest ship.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *He makes her hold the recording. His objection is not theatrical; he has seen formations fail because captains each saved the nearest ship.*

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: GRAVEFIRE — DEPARTURE MOUTH

dialogueInline.speaker: PASSENGER
dialogueInline.text: They've gone. The escorts have gone.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: They're at the exit. They're meant to be at the exit. You'd be worried if they were still sitting here.

dialogueInline.speaker: PASSENGER
dialogueInline.text: I can't get the buckle closed.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: Here. You pull this. No, the other part. It's a terrible buckle. I designed a better one once and nobody paid me to install it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ENGINEER
dialogueInline.text: Port radiator won't take much more.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: How much is much?

dialogueInline.speaker: ENGINEER
dialogueInline.text: I was hoping you'd ask for something less specific.

dialogueInline.speaker: TESS
dialogueInline.text: Then tell me when we have to get clear. Until then, the last skiffs get their escort.

panelPlan: Gravefire stays in the departure mouth. Heat wash eats through its limited cooling margin. The port radiator is already damaged and now takes another strain..
She closes it for him, then returns to the helm while the engine crew reads off increasing temperatures.
The final craft passes into protection. Tess takes Gravefire out on an exhausted and damaged cooling system.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: ADMIRALTY INQUIRY

dialogueInline.speaker: SELENE
dialogueInline.text: The junior escort left its screen at 14:06. Thunderbreak began covering the resulting gap at 14:08. By the time the escort reached the drifting tug, you had reduced protection along the reserve flank.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Yes.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: You sound comfortable with that.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Would you prefer I had the times wrong?

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: I'd prefer you understood why you're here.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I've had three hours to form a theory.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: Then share it.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: You want to know why I covered an officer who'd already disobeyed a standing order.

panelPlan: ADMIRALTY INQUIRY. Deka is exhausted. Dominion's questions have been running for hours. Selene has the synchronized escort, cruiser and tug telemetry. This is.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: The escort's decision is being reviewed separately. You had an opportunity to restore the screen by recalling that ship. Instead you moved a heavy cruiser out of its assigned geometry and exposed the ships behind it.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I tried the recall. The officer reported that the tug couldn't reach the safe lane. By the time the escort answered, it was already committed.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: You could have left them there.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Yes.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: Every captain holds position because every other captain depends on them. You don't get to reorganize a defense around an officer's moment of conscience.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I know how formations work, Admiral. It was my formation until that escort left it.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: And you made it weaker.

panelPlan: That admission bothers Dominion more than a justification would.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *That admission bothers Dominion more than a justification would.*

summary: THE RECORD (INSERTION PROPOSAL AFTER OPERATIONS; 7 PAGES NOT PRESUMED) — 3/6

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I made the reserve weaker. I made that escort's withdrawal survivable. I'm not claiming those are the same thing.

dialogueInline.speaker: SELENE
dialogueInline.text: The hostile third screen had a firing opportunity on Thunderbreak's exposed side. It did not fire.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: Which is fortunate.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Very. I dislike being lucky in the official record. It makes the next person think luck is a procedure.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I hope not.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: I asked what you would do, not what you would wish for.

panelPlan: Selene turns to the later telemetry. The tug was recovered; no one aboard died. Dominion asks whether Deka would repeat her choice.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.
sourceActionBeats: *Selene turns to the later telemetry. The tug was recovered; no one aboard died. Dominion asks whether Deka would repeat her choice.*

summary: THE RECORD (INSERTION PROPOSAL AFTER OPERATIONS; 7 PAGES NOT PRESUMED) — 4/6

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: If I say I'd always cover them, I teach every junior officer they can break the line and let Thunderbreak carry the cost. If I say I'd never cover them, I tell a crew in a crippled tug that the regulations matter more than whether they come home. I can't give you either answer without lying.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: You appear to think that uncertainty excuses you from command.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: No. Uncertainty is most of command. We try very hard not to put that on the recruitment posters.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: There were civilians behind the reserve as well as on the tug. If the third screen had attacked, they could have died because of your maneuver.

panelPlan: He does not smile. She doesn't expect him to.
directionInline: Use supplied Rex Fleet references; retain scene continuity; exact scripted lettering only.

summary: THE RECORD (INSERTION PROPOSAL AFTER OPERATIONS; 7 PAGES NOT PRESUMED) — 5/6

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Yes. That is the part I can't stop thinking about.

dialogueInline.speaker: SELENE
dialogueInline.text: All the tug's passengers survived, including the family the escort reported trapped against a damaged pressure hatch.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: The pilot kept trying to thank me when we finally got a signal. I told him I hadn't been the one who went out after them. He didn't seem to care who did which part.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: Does it matter to you?

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: It matters very much. That junior officer chose the rescue. I chose to cover it. If one of us had been wrong in a different way, a great many people would have paid for that distinction.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: You understand that this may cost you your ship.

panelPlan: Selene records the answer without tidying it.

summary: THE RECORD (INSERTION PROPOSAL AFTER OPERATIONS; 7 PAGES NOT PRESUMED) — 6/6

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: I thought about that when we turned. Then I had to stop thinking about it. There were other things to do.

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: Enter both decisions. The escort's unauthorized departure, and Thunderbreak's protective maneuver. No finding until the escort's testimony is reviewed.

dialogueInline.speaker: SELENE
dialogueInline.text: Already separated in the record.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Could I ask one question before you send me away?

dialogueInline.speaker: DOMINION
dialogueInline.text: If it's relevant.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Did the tug get repaired? I've asked twice. I keep getting transferred to inquiry personnel.

dialogueInline.speaker: SELENE
dialogueInline.text: Refit completed. It was back at the civilian berth yesterday.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Oh.

dialogueInline.speaker: DEKA
dialogueInline.text: Good.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: ASHFANG COMMAND

dialogueInline.speaker: EMISSARY
dialogueInline.text: The farms must be put beyond use. Their private harvests are undermining the Confederacy supply position.

dialogueInline.speaker: BILLIE
dialogueInline.text: They're growing food.

dialogueInline.speaker: EMISSARY
dialogueInline.text: They're controlling distribution without authorization.

dialogueInline.speaker: BILLIE
dialogueInline.text: If you want their stores counted, count them. I'm not burning fields belonging to people who have already waited through two bad seasons.

dialogueInline.speaker: EMISSARY
dialogueInline.text: The Triarch can withhold your tankers.

dialogueInline.speaker: BILLIE
dialogueInline.text: Yes. I noticed the last one wasn't exactly early.

dialogueInline.speaker: BILLIE
dialogueInline.text: Tell them no.

dialogueInline.speaker: OFFICER
dialogueInline.text: We can't keep Ashfang in the lane with half tanks.

dialogueInline.speaker: BILLIE
dialogueInline.text: I know. Start asking who has fuel we can actually buy.

dialogueInline.speaker: OFFICER
dialogueInline.text: You think anyone's selling to us after what happened today?

dialogueInline.speaker: BILLIE
dialogueInline.text: I think we're about to find out how many friends I've got.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: AURIC — ARRIVALS FREIGHT HALL

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: All the registered families made the crossing. We lost the relief pallet.

dialogueInline.speaker: HALEV
dialogueInline.text: The heated berths are ready. The food allotment was calculated with the pallet.

dialogueInline.speaker: NAOMI
dialogueInline.text: Then recalculate it. I'm not telling them the story ends when the door opens.

dialogueInline.speaker: PILOT
dialogueInline.text: Captain, your broadcast's live again.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIKE
dialogueInline.text: Turn it off. Somebody bring the lower ramp here.

dialogueInline.speaker: FEAR MASK
dialogueInline.text: They will remember the danger better than they remember the arrival. They need only be shown what frightened them.

dialogueInline.speaker: CHILD
dialogueInline.text: Are we staying?

dialogueInline.speaker: MOTHER
dialogueInline.text: Tonight we are.

dialogueInline.speaker: CHILD
dialogueInline.text: Tomorrow?

dialogueInline.speaker: MOTHER
dialogueInline.text: Tomorrow we ask again.

sourceActionBeats: *Auric receives the final skiffs. Families are warm for the night, though some sleep on the freight hall floor. A relief pallet did not survive. Naomi reports that loss to Halev instead of allowing the passage to be remembered as perfect.*
*At the dock Pike returns with the tug he saved. People begin shouting his name. He seems ready to enjoy the acclaim until he sees the crew struggling to unload a stretcher from a narrow hatch.*
*He steps into the work instead of posing. Abby observes without commenting. The gesture does not absolve the captain's earlier obstruction.*
*In the shadow warrens, the Fear Mask orders selective release of real footage. The records are authentic; their arrangement is calculated to imply that no crossing can be trusted.*
*At Auric, the girl from the queue finds her mother in a warm berth. She looks for a permanent room on the arrivals board and finds none.*
*Outside the berth, Naomi hears it. She takes the lost-pallet accounting to the civic office herself.*
